# Explicit commit messages and fixups take precedence over filling.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-06T20:00:00Z'

mkdir repo
cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m Initial
gs repo init
gs branch create feature --no-commit

git config spice.message.fill.command mock-message
git config spice.message.fill true
env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=8

gs commit create --allow-empty -m Explicit
gs commit create --allow-empty --fill --fixup HEAD
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^fixup! Explicit$'

gs commit create --allow-empty --fill --message-file $WORK/message.txt
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^From file$'

gs commit create --allow-empty --fill -m Explicit
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^Explicit$'

gs commit amend --fill --allow-empty -m 'Explicit amendment'
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^Explicit amendment$'

-- message.txt --
From file
